as_above.purpose: Machine-actionable CCR core axioms. These rules annotate claims with deterministic rule hits and required receipts for correction.
nonnegotiables: Deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs
Every correction must cite a receipt requirement

rule_format.match_semantics: case-insensitive substring over claim_text or feature keys

rules.name: Dimensional consistency is non-negotiable
rules.statement: Any quantitative claim or equation must be dimensionally consistent; otherwise it is invalid until repaired.

transform.correction_intent: Require explicit units; reject or repair equations that fail dimensional analysis.

receipt_requirements.notes: units_check_receipt can be a local calculation receipt that shows dimensional balance.

rules.name: Definitions before derivations
rules.statement: A symbol must be defined (units, meaning, scope) before it can be used in a derivation or law.

transform.correction_intent: Require symbol table and units before accepting downstream claims.

receipt_requirements.notes: symbol_table_receipt is a structured listing of symbols and units.

rules.name: Conservation claims require boundary conditions
rules.statement: Any conservation statement must specify system boundaries and assumptions (closed/open, external work, dissipation).

transform.correction_intent: Attach required boundary conditions; flag incomplete conservation claims.

receipt_requirements.notes: boundary_conditions_receipt captures explicit assumptions for the claim.

rules.name: CCR placeholders for QPhiD/QGC/AngleClock integration
rules.statement: This rule marks claims that appear to touch QPhiD/QGC/AngleClock vocabulary. Replace with your canonical CCR/QPhiD/QGC rules as you encode them.

transform.correction_intent: Route to the appropriate ruleset once QPhiD/QGC/AngleClock rule specs are filled.

receipt_requirements.notes: This is intentionally a bridge rule.

so_below.purpose_human: These are the CCR core axioms in a form the repo can execute. Each rule declares how to recognize a claim and what receipts are required to correct it.
how_to_extend: Add a new rule with a new id (CCR-AX-XXXX).
Set transform.action to annotate_only until you formalize rewrite transforms.
notes: This file is tracked; generated receipts are not.
Next step is to replace placeholders with your canonical CCR/QPhiD/QGC/AngleClock rule content.
